test_vca_enabled_with_correct_tracker.title: Verify VCA is enabled with DL Object Tracker + Intrusion Detection

steps.expected: The CONFIGURATION page is shown with Enable set to On.
DL Object Tracker is selected with Intrusion detection as its active option, and DL People Tracker is listed as the alternative.

test_vca_rules_and_license.title: Verify VCA has active rules and valid ProAI license

steps.expected: The RULES page lists the rules and has an Add button.
The LICENSE page shows the camera's expected license (from the registry) under Activated License.

steps.action: On a multi-lens camera, count the activated license rows.
steps.expected: One row per lens (four on the MS-20V-1 units).

test_cloud_connect_registered.title: Verify camera is registered to Soterix staging cloud

steps.expected: The SOTERIX CLOUD CONNECT page loads with the Soterix logo.

steps.action: Wait a few seconds for the cloud status to load and read it.
steps.expected: Registered Cloud Address shows staging.example.invalid. "Waiting for cloud registration..." or "I am not registered to a cloud." means the camera was never registered: finish provisioning (QR code) and run again.
Upload QR Code with Select QR, Upload and Reset buttons.

test_multi_lens_license_count_matches_le.title: Verify multi-lens camera has one license assigned per lens

steps.action: On a multi-lens camera, open Setup > VCA > LICENSE.
Compare the registry's expected license count with its lens count.
steps.expected: They match (four for the MS-20V-1 units).

steps.action: Count the activated licenses marked assigned.
